description: This PHP source file defines the LengthClass model for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, providing methods for managing length class records in the database, including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and descriptions handling.
external_files: related database tables: length_class and length_class_description

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Model class for managing length units and their descriptions in the OpenCart localization module.

methods.name: addLengthClass
methods.description: Creates a new length class record in the database and adds descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editLengthClass
methods.description: Updates an existing length class record and replaces its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteLengthClass
methods.description: Deletes a length class record and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: deleteLengthClassesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getLengthClass
methods.description: Retrieves a length class record with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getLengthClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of length classes, possibly filtered and sorted.

methods.name: getTotalLengthClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of length class records.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific length class and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a length class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific length class description for a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given length class.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all length class descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptionByUnit
methods.description: Retrieves a length class description based on the unit (e.g., 'cm').
